itinerary.title: Arrival - HCM Shopping Tour
activities: Suggested arrival time: 12pm or earlier
Arrive Tan Son Nhat International Airport (SGN)
Wholesale Shopping Tour - Baju Kurung, Tudung, Telekung, Shoes & Bag
Free & Easy - street night market

itinerary.title: Mekong River - Shopping & Food Tour
activities: Mekong Tour: Tien (Mekong) River Delta's Dragon, Unicorn, Tortoise and Phoenix Islands
Honey Bee-farm (taste delicious honey tea with lemon)
Coconut candy workshop (witness and try to do it)
Ride on horse-cart
Visit / pray @ My Tho Mosque, lunch
Dainy or Sarah (wholesale market)
Free & Easy - street night market

itinerary.title: Chu Chi Tunnel - City - Shopping & Food Tour
activities: Chu Chi Tunnel Tour (underground tunnel during the Vietnam wars)
Visit / pray @ Jamia Al Muslimin Mosque
Vietnam War Museum (the War Remnants Museum)
Central Post Office (Vietnam's largest post office)
Notre Dame Cathedral
Opera House
Shopping Tour - Taka Plaza, Saigon Square

itinerary.title: Shopping Tour
activities: Suggested departure time: 2pm onwards
Shopping at Ben Thanh Market
Transfer to Tan Son Nhat International Airport (SGN)

expect.title: Attraction Places
expect.body: Attractions may require a long journey to reach — 2 to 3 hours each way.

expect.title: Prepare for Weather
expect.body: Rainy May - October. Sunny November - April.

expect.title: Full Board Meals
expect.body: Meals are already included in the package. If you choose not to consume them, no refund will be provided.

expect.title: Luggage Allocation
expect.body: Please bring a maximum of 1 luggage per pax, as it affects car capacity.

expect.title: Hotel Locations
expect.body: Hotels near the city centre are prioritised. If none are available, the hotel will be just outside the city centre.

expect.title: Lots of Walking
expect.body: Some attractions require a lot of walking, for example the Chu Chi Tunnel.
